question: What will be the percentage change in the US dollar to Japanese yen exchange rate (USDJPY=X on Yahoo Finance) from the close on 2026-09-15 to the close on 2026-09-26?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to 100 x (close on 2026-09-26 / close on 2026-09-15 - 1), using daily closes of USDJPY=X on Yahoo Finance. If there is no close on 2026-09-26, the last close before it is used.
research:
# USD/JPY: % change from the 2026-09-15 close to the 2026-09-26 close, research notes (as of 2026-09-16)

## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on Yahoo Finance USDJPY=X daily closes. I tried to fetch https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/USDJPY=X/history/ and the proxy refused the connection, so **I could not read the official 2026-09-15 close.**
- 2026-09-15: FOREX.com said USD/JPY had "extend[ed] its recovery to around 155.00," which it called a pivotal level, after bouncing from a seven-month low. [FOREX.com](https://www.forex.com/en/news-and-analysis/usd-jpy-outlook-currency-pair-of-the-week-september-15-2026/)
- 2026-09-16: before the Fed decision the pair was reported near 155.01 to 155.13, so the 9-15 close was probably in the mid-154s to about 155. This is not confirmed. [RoboForex](https://roboforex.com/beginners/analytics/forex-forecast/currencies/usd-jpy-forecast-2026-09-16/), [note.com market report](https://note.com/hirokimiyano/n/ndbfadddbc617?hl=en)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. It covers about 8 trading days, and two central bank decisions fall early in that window.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-16: a Japan market report put USD/JPY at about 155.13, up about 0.5% on the day, with higher oil prices weighing on the yen. The Dollar Index was 99.647. [note.com](https://note.com/hirokimiyano/n/ndbfadddbc617?hl=en)
- 2026-09-16: RoboForex said markets priced about a 92% chance of a 25 bp Fed **hike** to 3.75-4.00% at that day's FOMC. It also said a BoJ hike to 1.25% was expected. [RoboForex](https://roboforex.com/beginners/analytics/forex-forecast/currencies/usd-jpy-forecast-2026-09-16/)
- 2026-09-15: FOREX.com said rising US yields and oil prices were driving the rebound, and that a 25 bp Fed hike was widely expected. [FOREX.com](https://www.forex.com/en/news-and-analysis/usd-jpy-outlook-currency-pair-of-the-week-september-15-2026/)
- 2026-09-14: Wise listed 153.42 as the month's low rate. [Wise](https://wise.com/gb/currency-converter/usd-to-jpy-rate/history)
- About 2026-09-10: USD/JPY was near 153.40-153.50. [Octagon AI](https://www.octagonai.co/markets/financials/foreign-exchange/usdjpy-price-on-sep-11-at-5-00-pm-edt/)
- 2026-09-03: the yen hit a one-month intraday high as traders weighed the chance of more intervention. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/03/yen-japan-intervention-boj.html)
- 2026-08-03: Japan and the US confirmed a joint yen intervention, the first since 2011. Japan bought about ¥8.45tn (about $52.8bn) after the yen weakened to nearly 164, and the pair then fell from 163.73 to 157.57. Both governments said they were ready to act again. [Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/business/2026/08/03/markets/japan-us-joint-yen-intervention/), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/03/yen-intervention-us-japan-trump-bessent-katayama.html), [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_U.S.%E2%80%93Japan_yen_intervention)

## 4. Base rates
- I could not download a daily price series, so these numbers are my own rough estimates.
- USD/JPY realized volatility is typically about 8-12% a year. Over about 8 trading days that works out to a 1-sigma move of roughly 1.4-2.0%, centered near 0%.
- Recent range: about 164 in late July, about 157.6 after the intervention, about 153.4 on 9-14, and about 155 on 9-15/16. That is a 1.0-1.5% swing within a few days in mid-September and about a 6% swing over the previous six weeks. Volatility is currently above normal.
- Intervention episodes can move the pair 2-4% in a day or two. The August action moved it about 3.8% (163.73 to 157.57).
- Moves larger than ±5% (the edge of the question's range) over about 8 trading days are rare outside intervention or crisis periods.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on this exact window.
- Kalshi runs weekly USD/JPY price markets (for example, the price on Sep 11 at 5pm EDT). A market for the Sep 25 close may exist, but I could not get its prices. [Octagon tracker](https://www.octagonai.co/markets/topics/usdjpy-weekly/)
- Polymarket has thin-volume 2026 "hit" markets (about $13K total). One snapshot priced about 55% on hitting 165. [SimpleFunctions](https://simplefunctions.dev/answer/usdjpy-hit)
- BoJ hike pricing for Sept 18 conflicts between sources:
  - 2026-09-01: OIS pricing implied about a 98% chance of a hike. [BlueGamma](https://www.bluegamma.io/central-banks/central-bank-interest-rate-forecasts/the-bank-of-japan-interest-rate-forecast)
  - An undated prediction-market snapshot showed only about 36.8%. [PredictionHunt](https://www.predictionhunt.com/odds/bank-of-japan-rate-decision-in-september/29088)
- FXEmpire framed the setup as "USD/JPY eyes 156.80 as markets price the BoJ's September hike." [FXEmpire](https://www.fxempire.com/forecasts/article/premium-usd-jpy-eyes-156-80-as-markets-price-the-bojs-september-hike-1629504)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-09-16: FOMC decision and press conference. A hike is mostly priced in, so the guidance and dot plot are the swing factors.
- 2026-09-17/18: BoJ meeting, with an expected hike from 1.00% to 1.25%. The vote split and Ueda's guidance matter.
- 2026-09-21 and 2026-09-22/23: Japanese holidays (Respect for the Aged Day and the Autumnal Equinox), which thin Tokyo liquidity.
- About 2026-09-25: Tokyo September CPI. US data that week may include final GDP and PCE; I have not confirmed the dates.
- Ongoing risks:
  - Japanese MOF intervention: Katayama's standing warnings and the US-Japan readiness to act again, although the 155 level is well below the roughly 160-164 zone where action came before.
  - Moves in oil prices and US yields.
